$description: LinkedIn colour rules for Scaalus. Moods come from moods/*.json; this file only says which moods to favour and how gradients adapt to each format.

theme-mix.note: LinkedIn reads professional and calm — lean light, with dark for offers, launches and big proof numbers.

formats.name: Carousel (PDF document)
formats.note: One mood for the whole document. Cover carries the mass; inner pages use the same ground with the mass at 0–15%.

formats.name: Profile / page banner
formats.calm-zones: Left 400 px is covered by the profile photo on mobile — plain ground only.

note: Text-heavy posts: prefer Daylight. Never put more than one line of supporting text on Electric.
